camera_distance_note: Lower focal values cover real HuMMan roughly 2-3 m depths while keeping full bodies in the 640x480 frame; distances determined from fixed multi-pose bounds, never model predictions
lr_selection: minimum mean VAL identity-equal vertex_camera_mm across all three methods at epoch 5; tie selects 1e-4; never real/test
scheduler: cosine decay to 0.1 initial lr; 2 epoch linear warmup
checkpoint_selection: best synthetic VAL identity-equal vertex_camera_mm; also retain last
real_evaluation_samples: all 232 prepared TRAIN/VAL timestamps; no TEST
trainable: existing feature adapter only; official backbone/decoder/heads/MHR frozen
cache: native backbone output bfloat16, same dtype as official; parameter forward numerical equivalence QA <=2e-6, vertices <=0.001 mm; not bitwise prediction equality
limitations: Procedural surface colour patterns, modest native poses and shape variation; no photoreal clothing, bed/contact deformation or clinical points. Real evaluation is transfer diagnosis; no absolute GT accuracy or unseen-by-official-pretraining claim.
